title: Concept: Go dependency pinned to a pseudo-version
description: go.mod declares a pseudo-version, which names a commit that carries no release tag, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The commit has no release review, no changelog and no version that an advisory range can describe, yet it is what compiles.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The commit has no release review, no changelog and no version that an advisory range can describe, yet it is what compiles.
